summary: Tested 'Play with Coach' chat feature fixes for LLM hallucinations. All tests pass. Found and fixed a frontend bug where chat button was passing event object instead of null to sendChatMessage function, causing React render error.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: onClick={sendChatMessage} was passing event object as directMessage parameter, causing 'Objects are not valid as a React child' error. Changed to onClick={() => sendChatMessage()}

context_for_next_testing_agent: Coach Play chat feature is fully tested. Backend hallucination fixes are working: 1) Chat gives position-specific advice with Stockfish analysis, 2) Move quality is correctly assessed, 3) Best move comes from Stockfish, 4) No false opening claims for unusual moves like h3, 5) Messages have IDs for feedback button. Frontend had a bug where chat send button passed event object to sendChatMessage, causing React error - this was fixed by changing onClick={sendChatMessage} to onClick={() => sendChatMessage()}.

bug_fixed.issue: onClick={sendChatMessage} passed React event object as first argument to sendChatMessage(directMessage), which expected null or string
bug_fixed.fix: Changed to onClick={() => sendChatMessage()} to call with no arguments
bug_fixed.root_cause: When a React onClick handler directly references a function without an arrow wrapper, the event object is passed as the first argument
